verdict.rationale: kitty ships an official remote-control CLI (`kitten @`) that is documented first-party for driving the terminal from scripts or the shell: opening windows, sending text, and changing titles. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed a complete agent-control loop: `ls` returned JSON state, and `send-text`, `get-text` and `close-window` all worked against a live instance. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of CLI use in agent or AI workflows.
